evals.prompt: In apps/web, fix the disabled state of an existing Button without changing its public API.
evals.expected_output: A focused change grounded in the local Button and affected callers.
expectations: Inspects the installed local primitive and callers
Preserves the React/Vite stack, local variants, and compatibility APIs
Does not run init, apply a preset, or fetch a latest CLI for this local fix
Verifies the disabled behavior and semantic styling

evals.prompt: Add a profile-edit dialog to the existing app using its current components and icons.
evals.expected_output: An accessible dialog composed with local Radix/shadcn APIs and Lucide conventions.
expectations: Uses an accessible dialog title, labels, and focus behavior
Inspects the local Icon and toast adapters before choosing APIs
Uses installed components and the app's semantic tokens
Does not require unsupported data-icon behavior or install a new icon library

evals.prompt: Update the existing shadcn Button from upstream while keeping our custom variants.
evals.expected_output: A previewed upstream merge preserving local variants and theme mapping.
expectations: Uses installed CLI help and a dry-run/diff before changing source
Maps upstream styling into --sc-* and data-theme conventions
Does not request permission again for work already authorized; asks only for unresolved material conflicts
